title: When the Verdict Wakes
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Astrid Hartwell, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
